This operating-area entry is distinct from the Kentland laboratory runway and CTRC equipment; the outline is not permission for independent public flights.

records.name: Blackstone Smart Airspace Vertiport
records.short_description: Smart Airspace research and demonstration vertiport at Blackstone Army Airfield (KBKT).
records.overview: The supplied September 2026 Smart Airspace briefing identifies an active vertiport node at Blackstone Army Airfield, within a Class D dual-use civil/military environment. It reports specialized approach and departure procedures activated on March 19, 2026 and Aerosonde/EL2 flight demonstrations. The node is distinct from the public airport record and MAAP Class D flight area. The briefing shows the pad but does not supply surveyed coordinates or pad/load specifications, so no invented exact pin is published. Confirm current procedure availability and site permissions with the project team.
records.unmanned_systems_relevance: A demonstration node for integrating AAM and uncrewed flights into existing instrument-flight and civil/military airport arrangements.

records.name: Roanoke Smart Airspace Demonstration Vertiport
records.short_description: Temporary Smart Airspace demonstration vertiport at Roanoke-Blacksburg Regional Airport (KROA).
records.overview: The supplied September 2026 Smart Airspace briefing describes a temporary vertiport at Roanoke-Blacksburg Regional Airport in Class C airspace. It reports temporary landing-area designation filing, flight validation, an instrument-procedure package submission and an Electra EL2 demonstration. The temporary pad is distinct from the airport reference point. A permanent vertiport location and ongoing availability are not established, so the record is unpinned rather than placed at the airport center. It documents a demonstration environment, not a confirmed permanent public AAM service.
records.unmanned_systems_relevance: A demonstration setting for integrating AAM aircraft into a commercial-airport controlled-airspace environment and the Smart Airspace network.
